  str_flatten(collapse = "|")

emotions <- c("\\blove", "\\bhate") |> 
  str_flatten(collapse = "|")

word_matches <- tokens1_raw |> 
  filter(type == "dialogue") |> 
  collect() |> 
  filter(str_detect(word, "\\brookie")) |>
  group_by(season) |> 
  count(word)

word_matches

word_matches |> 
  ggplot(aes(word, n)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), nudge_y = 10) +
  facet_wrap(~ season, nrow = 2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1)) +
  theme_light()
